Respawn Teleport - lands at the player's active respawn; one row per respawn gated on its *_SPAWN varbit (same convention as the Respawn Portal rows in teleportation_portals_poh.tsv)

Lumbridge Home Teleport (varp 4560 is a bitmask of enabled animation overrides, bit order = animation menu order: 1=Default 24t, 2=Runefest 21t, 4=Speedy 19t, 8=Armageddon 24t, 16=League I Twisted 24t, 32=League II Trailblazer 25t, 64=League III Shattered 20t, 128=League IV Trailblazer Reloaded 21t, 256=League V Raging Echoes 21t, 512=Annihilation 19t, 1024=League VI Demonic Pacts 23t; multiple enabled bits choose randomly; 892@30 is the 30-minute cooldown)
